components.title: Solve marble probability
components.what: Count all three-marble draws and subtract the outcomes with three distinct colors to find the probability that at least two share a color; reduce fraction to lowest terms.

components.title: Sum qualifying integers
components.what: Use arithmetic progressions or inclusion-exclusion to sum integers from 610 through 9824 divisible by 7 but not by 6 (i.e. divisible by 7, exclude those divisible by 42).

components.title: Count business days
components.what: Advance 81 weekdays from 2026-09-19, skipping Saturdays/Sundays and excluding the specified holidays if they fall on a counted weekday, to identify the resulting date.

components.title: Multiply and digit-sum
components.what: Compute the product 77375 × 5264 × 122 × 6083 exactly and sum the decimal digits of the result.
